title: Block Tensor Rank of Sum-Rank Metric Codes
summary: Sum-rank codes provide a generalized framework for Hamming and rank-metric codes, with codewords represented as tuples of matrices and weight given by the sum of the block ranks. In this paper, we introduce and study a block-tensor-rank invariant for sum-rank metric codes. To each code, we associate its \emph{block tensor rank}: the smallest number of block-simple tensors, namely rank-one matrices supported inside single blocks, whose linear span contains the code.
